ev_0004.summary: Full circle (center O, radius 354.31 px) with three points on it: A (top), B (lower-left), C (lower-right). Chords AB and AC are drawn as solid lines. M lies on AB and N lies on AC; both were checked by collinearity (M is within 0.3 px of AB, N within 0.1 px of AC). Segments OA, OM and ON are drawn from the center to A and to the chord points. OM and ON are not radii: |OM| is about 199 px and |ON| about 165 px, both well short of 354.31 px. No BC segment is present. No dashed lines and no right-angle marks were detected, so no right-angle object is submitted. The CV fragments ON (seg_05 + seg_06) were merged into one segment, and the small overshoots of the detector spans were snapped to the labelled vertices.
